description: Cycle network is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Bristol City Council www.betterbybike.info. The Cycle Network Map is a GIS database of existing and proposed cycle routes in Bristol, used by BCC for maintaining and planning the cycle network. It includes the strategic cycle network, location of cycling infrastructure, vehicle and cycle flows, and proposed schemes. The intention is to update the database quarterly. Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Transport & Streets, Leisure & Tourism. Its keywords are Bristol City Council, Cycling, Bike, Better By Bike, transport. The portal shows 1,443 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
